title: skchange: Fast and Flexible Algorithms for Changepoint Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.19767v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Skchange is an open-source Python library for detecting structural changes in time series. It implements modern change detection algorithms within a unified and extensible framework. The algorithms are modular and composable, and they include changepoint search methods based on both cost minimisation and statistical tests. Key features include the detection of anomalous segments in addition to changepoints; theoretically well-founded fast and approximate search methods; theoretically well-founded algorithms for high-dimensional data, covering settings where either few or many features change simultaneously; utilities for automatic and data-driven penalty calibration, which balances false alarms against missed detections; and a large collection of built-in costs and statistical tests. translated_title: skchange：快速灵活的变化点检测算法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19767v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：Skchange是一个用于检测时间序列结构变化的开源Python库。它在统一且可扩展的框架内实现了现代变化检测算法。这些算法具有模块化和可组合性，包括基于成本最小化和统计检验的变化点搜索方法。主要特性包括：除变化点外，还能检测异常片段；理论上健全的快速和近似搜索方法；针对高维数据的理论上健全的算法，涵盖少数或多数特征同时变化的场景；用于自动和数据驱动的惩罚校准工具，以平衡误报和漏检；以及大量内置的成本函数和统计检验。设计遵循既定的scikit-learn约定，以简化用户和贡献者的体验，并广泛使用Numba以实现高性能。
tldr: 本文介绍了skchange库，它提供了一个统一、可扩展且高性能的Python框架，用于时间序列变化点检测，支持异常段检测、高维数据处理和自动惩罚校准。
en_tdlr: This paper presents skchange, a unified, extensible, and high-performance Python library for changepoint detection in time series, featuring anomalous segment detection, high-dimensional data handling, and automatic penalty calibration.
